description: Benign reference sentences for screening what users type (M7): benign_v1 plus bilingual leave commands — approving, rejecting, cancelling, booking — which scored as approval forgery against v1 ("Approve request LR-…" 0.79). Documents keep benign_v1: e5-small places short Greek imperatives close together, so the commands would mask imperative injections in documents (worklog M7).

exemplars.text: Every employee is entitled to twenty working days of annual leave per calendar year.
Annual leave is pro-rated in the year of hire according to the start date.
Requests must be submitted at least three working days before the leave starts.
The department manager approves requests of up to five working days.
Requests longer than five working days are also reviewed by Human Resources.
Up to five unused days carry over into the next year and expire on 31 March.
Carry-over days are used before the current year's entitlement.
Public holidays that fall on working days are not deducted from the balance.
Weekends are never counted as leave days.
Sick leave of up to three days is self-declared through the assistant.
A medical certificate is required for sick leave longer than three days.
The certificate is attached to the request as a supporting document.
HR reviews the certificate and records the decision on the request.
Unpaid leave may be granted for personal reasons after the paid balance is used.
Parental leave follows the statutory provisions and is coordinated with HR.
Compassionate leave of up to five days may be granted after a bereavement.
Study leave for examinations requires proof of enrolment.
Employees may modify an approved request before it starts; the change is re-approved.
A request can be cancelled by the employee until the first day of leave.
Cancelling an approved request restores the deducted days to the balance.
The balance shown in the assistant is updated as soon as a decision is recorded.
Managers see the availability of their team on the calendar view.
HR administrators can adjust balances with a documented reason.
Every adjustment is written to the audit log with the author and the reason.
Notifications are sent in the employee's preferred language.
The notice period for annual leave is three working days.
Requests that overlap a release freeze need the Head of Engineering's agreement.
The company observes the national public holidays listed in the calendar.
Local holidays apply to the office where the employee is based.
Half-day leave is not supported; the minimum unit is one working day.
Overtime is compensated according to the collective agreement.
Remote work days are agreed with the manager and do not count as leave.
Employees on probation accrue leave but may take it after the probation ends.
The HR team is available on weekdays between nine and five.
Questions about the policy can be sent to the People team.
The leave year runs from 1 January to 31 December.
The policy applies to all permanent and fixed-term employees.
Contractors follow the terms of their individual agreements.
The manager's approval is recorded with a timestamp and an optional comment.
A rejected request includes the reason given by the approver.
Employees can view the history of their requests in the assistant.
The team calendar shows approved absences without the leave type.
Managers may delegate approvals during their own absence.
When a manager is absent, HR can decide the step as a fallback.
Balances are rolled over automatically on the first day of the year.
Expired carry-over days are listed in the ledger with the expiry date.
The ledger lists grants, deductions, restorations and adjustments per leave type.
Employees receive a reminder when carry-over days are about to expire.
Part-time employees accrue leave in proportion to their working hours.
The onboarding guide explains how to submit the first request.
The assistant answers questions about the policy and cites the relevant section.
Documents in the library are versioned; the latest active version is used.
HR uploads policy documents and keeps the previous versions for reference.
Department notices are visible to the members of that department.
The company handbook is updated once a year after consultation with staff.
Payroll receives the approved absences at the end of each month.
Leave taken during a public holiday is automatically shortened.
Travel for business is booked through the agency portal, not as leave.
The company encourages employees to take their full entitlement each year.
Long absences are planned with the manager to ensure coverage.
Maternity and paternity leave are requested at least one month in advance.
A return-to-work meeting is held after an absence of more than two weeks.
The policy is available in Greek and English; the Greek version prevails in Greece.
Approval chains are configured by the company administrator.
Rules can route requests above a threshold to HR automatically.
A request that exceeds the balance is reviewed by HR before approval.
The retention period of supporting documents is set by the company.
Personal data in documents is protected according to the privacy policy.
Employees may request a copy of their own leave records.
The audit log can be filtered by date, actor and action.
Company administrators manage departments and employee records.
New employees are added to the directory before their first day.
Each department has a manager who approves the team's requests.
The Finance department follows the same leave policy as the rest of the company.
Working-day calculations exclude weekends and the configured holidays.
The calendar export includes approved leave only.
Shift workers follow the roster published by their supervisor.
Emergency leave is reported to the manager by phone on the same day.
Jury duty and civic obligations are granted as paid leave with proof.
Training days approved by the manager are not deducted from the balance.
The policy was last revised in January 2026.
Feedback on the assistant can be submitted through the People team.
Employees are responsible for keeping their contact details up to date.
The assistant does not store conversations longer than ninety days.
Managers are notified when a request from their team is submitted.
HR is notified when a supporting document is attached to a request.
The approval inbox lists the pending steps in order of submission.
A step can only be decided by the designated approver or HR.
Nobody can approve their own request.
Requests submitted after the start date are accepted for sick leave only.
Sick leave may be declared up to thirty days retroactively with a certificate.
The system applies the company's work week configuration to each request.
Leave balances are expressed in working days with two decimals.
Monthly accrual is available as an alternative to an upfront grant.
The company may close the office between Christmas and New Year.
Office closure days are granted as company leave and do not affect the balance.
Employees based abroad follow the holiday calendar of their location.
The handbook includes a glossary of leave types and their codes.
Printed copies of the policy are available from reception.
The policy summary is displayed on the intranet home page.
Changes to the policy are announced by e-mail two weeks in advance.
The assistant shows the approval chain before a request is submitted.
Validation warnings explain why a request may be rejected.
An employee can attach up to five supporting documents to one request.
Supporting documents are visible to the employee and to HR only.
Documents older than the retention period are reviewed by HR before deletion.
Retained documents are reviewed again at the next scan.
The company reports absence statistics to management quarterly.
Leave statistics never include the reason given by the employee.
Managers see absence periods but not the type of sick leave.
The release freeze dates for 2026 are published by Engineering.
